heading: “Servant of Government”.
text: The words “servant of Government” denote any officer or servant continued, appointed or employed in India by or under the authority of Government.]
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
